optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Channel Operations Analyst, Anti-Fraud Analytics Platform

professionalSummary.text: Senior-level analyst with over two and a half years of experience in fraud operations, specifically managing rule-change requests for partner banks within an anti-fraud analytics platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran intake for rule-change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years in the platform operations team... Responsibilities included request intake, impact checks, release scheduling and committee reporting for the rule-review channel, working with two colleagues under the head of platform operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed end-to-end rule-change request lifecycle including intake, impact checks, scheduling into fortnightly releases, and reporting to fraud steering committee for three partner banks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran intake for rule-change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years... logging each request in the channel tracker, running the impact check against the last 30 days of screened transactions, and placing approved changes into the fortnightly release. Prepared the monthly channel report for the fraud steering committee... Wrote the end-of-cycle notes for each release... Responsibilities included request intake, impact checks, release scheduling and committee reporting for the rule-review channel.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Documented rule-change requests and deferrals in a channel tracker with change history, including anonymized extracts for two release cycles and corresponding end-of-cycle notes.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: an anonymised channel tracker extract (request id, bank, impact-check result, release cycle, deferral reason) for two release cycles and the corresponding end-of-cycle notes, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.

skills.text: ACAMS Foundations certification in progress with CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.
skills.witness: Completed the ACAMS foundations e-learning modules and am currently preparing for the CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish two and a half years of experience in fraud operations, documented processes for rule-change management, and ACAMS Foundations completion with CAMS exam pending. The materials do not establish five years of experience or a CAMS/CFE certification.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has two and a half years of experience (below five-year requirement) and is pursuing CAMS certification (not yet held).
